VERBS-sim's `--controller` row gives the `fixture:<name>` form to this bead (N16ap4-01 hands `fixture:` to its loader), but the bead never defined that form, so `fixture:zero-gain` (used by N14b-09 and BD-244) had no loader and no file format. The evidence script passed `--task turn-radius-sweep`, `pivot-90-mu0.4` and `pivot-90-mu0.8` to sim run as bare names. These are task files this bead writes, not registered tasks, and sim.run's `--task` (N16ap4-01, VERBS-sim) refuses an unregistered name with 802. It takes a file path only after task.check has admitted it. So every sweep and pivot step would have been refused. The script now checks each fixtures/reflex/tasks/<t>.ftask with `frob task check` (a read verb) and passes the paths. The `--state estimated`, tier and key forms are unchanged.

The script ran `--task push-recovery` as a bare name, but no bead registers that task and this bead did not declare it as a file, so all 20 push trials would have been refused with 802 under sim.run's `--task` rule (N16ap4-01). The bead now names the task file it adds, fixtures/reflex/tasks/push-recovery.ftask (the 0.3 m/s lateral push over 0.1 s from the acceptance criteria), checks it first with `frob task check`, and passes it by path.

`weight-shift`, `push-recovery`, `threshold-crossing` and `reach-moving-target` were passed to sim run as bare names. No bead registers them, so sim.run would refuse each with 802 (N16ap4-01) and the frontier evidence script could not run. The bead now says these four are task files it adds under fixtures/reflex/tasks/, each checked with `frob task check` and passed by path. stand-10s and traverse-5m-flat stay BD-125's registered tasks.

design.check: place FROB-REF-808 at stage 1 (32 codes; design.patch then 112 plus 32). design.check takes a design file (NS-01), and stage 1 ('Parse either view', N14b-10 row 1) is where N14a-01's reader runs. Row 1 already owns the reader's 102, 103 and 125. Rule 5's 808 (a JSON integer outside ±(2⁵³ − 1)) is therefore raised inside stage 1, and while 808 is outside the row the out-of-row conformance check (N14b-10) rejects the runner on any such file. The alternative is a runner that drops the code or rounds the integer silently. When the row lists 808 at stage 1, N14b-10 adds it to row 1 and to refusal_union_matches_registry (30 codes there). This answers H-verbs-2's question to N14b-10.
